mapper.insert: insert into cynexus_appl_market.portfolio_import_asset (id, principal_key, tenant_key, file_name, content_type, byte_size, content_sha256, content_bytes, retention_until) values (#{id}, #{principalKey}, #{tenantKey}, #{fileName}, #{contentType}, #{byteSize}, #{contentSha256}, #{contentBytes}, #{retentionUntil})
mapper.select: select id, principal_key, tenant_key, file_name, content_type, byte_size, content_sha256, content_bytes, retention_until from cynexus_appl_market.portfolio_import_asset where id = #{assetId} and deleted_at is null and purged_at is null
mapper.insert: insert into cynexus_appl_market.portfolio_import_task (id, principal_key, tenant_key, asset_id, status, version, attempt_count, idempotency_key) values (#{id}, #{principalKey}, #{tenantKey}, #{assetId}, #{status}, #{version}, #{attemptCount}, #{idempotencyKey})
mapper.update: update cynexus_appl_market.portfolio_import_task set status = #{status}, version = #{version}, attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, queued_at = #{queuedAt}, started_at = #{startedAt}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, confirmed_at = #{confirmedAt}, last_error_code = #{lastErrorCode}, last_error_message = #{lastErrorMessage}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and version = #{version} - 1 and deleted_at is null
